decisions.label: Female
decisions.description: An individual who belongs to the sex that normally produces ova.

verification.note: NCIT:C16576 Female; exact label match. Note this is the biological sex qualifier in NCIT; gender and biological sex are distinct concepts but NCIT does not maintain separate gender vs. sex qualifier hierarchies. This is the standard NCIT term used for this purpose.

decisions.label: Male
decisions.description: An individual who belongs to the sex that normally produces sperm.

verification.note: NCIT:C20197 Male; exact label match. Same note as Female: used as a sex-aligned gender qualifier.

decisions.label: Intersex
decisions.description: Refers to an individual who was born with genitalia, chromosomes, or reproductive organs that do not fit typical definitions for either male or female.

decisions.label: Unknown
decisions.description: Not known, observed, recorded, or reported as unknown by the data contributor.

decisions.label: Unspecified
decisions.description: Not stated explicitly or in detail.

verification.note: NCIT:C38046 Unspecified; standard NCIT missing-value qualifier.
NCIT:C43234 Not Reported; standard NCIT qualifier.
